scope: Replace the misleading Android-release game label with an edition-qualified key for the J2ME game build documented by the upstream compatibility engine. This supersedes the earlier Deep 3D platform-only patch in this folder.

fields.platform: Original Fishlabs DEEP J2ME/MIDlet game data (Sony Ericsson 1.0.8 JAR) → TheWWWorm fan-made Android compatibility-engine APK/libraries → Nintendo Switch homebrew
fields.summary: An unofficial Nintendo Switch port of TheWWWorm’s fan-made compatibility-engine edition for Fishlabs’ original DEEP: Submarine Odyssey. The upstream engine is developed and gameplay-checked against the Sony Ericsson 1.0.8 DEEP JAR, and the Switch port can import an original DEEP JAR directly. Android APK/libraries describe compatibility-engine components, not a later official Fishlabs Android game release.
